highlights.title: Corporate CRM (full-stack)
highlights.text: end-to-end implementation (controllers, services and views) of the Quotes, Orders, Delivery Notes and Invoices sales modules, with the business logic and the conversion flows between documents. It was the most complex module of the period. Optimization of Data Annotations to ensure data integrity.

highlights.title: Legacy software modernization
highlights.text: refactoring and upgrading of legacy systems in production towards a component-based architecture and modern visual standards, preserving the original business logic.

highlights.title: Backend and e-commerce
highlights.text: relational database modeling with Entity Framework (Code-First), migration of processes to asynchronous communication (AJAX/JSON/jQuery) and conditional navigation secured with ASP.NET Identity.

moodnest.name: MoodNest
moodnest.summary: web application for daily mood tracking in the face of stress and hyper-digitalization. Contextualized logging of emotions and activities, with a complete data analysis module.
moodnest.engineering: complete lifecycle (requirements, physical/logical/data architecture, implementation, testing and validation of non-functional requirements: performance, security, usability). Agile management with GitHub: Issues, Milestones and Kanban board.
stack: REST API in Java with Spring Boot and stateless authentication with JWT
screenshotAlts: MoodNest landing page (interface in Spanish): a headline about taking control of your emotional well-being and a button to start your diary for free
MoodNest dashboard: a greeting, a streak counter, a button to log the day and the scores of the last five entries
June 2026 calendar with each day colored by its score and, beside it, the details of 26 June: overall score 9, a comment and tags
Analysis and statistics screen: a chart of mood over time with the monthly average score from February to August
More statistics: days tagged #Amigos (friends) score 2 points higher, the average score by day of the week and a donut chart of days by score
